title: pi-lhc auto-compact only fires between turns; a long turn can run far past its trigger
description: Per-model auto-compact fires only at agent_end; a single monster run can drift past the trigger until PI's native backstop (contextWindow−16k, loop-safe, still routes through LHC). Options if it starts hurting: models.json contextWindow override per model (existing dev pattern), fork patch for deferred ctx.compact, or upstream API ask (extensions can intercept compacts but cannot schedule one without aborting — well-shaped proposal). Lee: leave open, right solution probably patched fork, wait for a bigger reason.
